rows.note: This is the all-purpose adjective for something that has value or merit.

example.english: For people wanting to change careers, this course is really worthy of their time.
example.traditional: 呢個課程對想轉行嘅人嚟講好有價值。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 fo3 cing4 deoi3 soeng2 zyun2 hong4 ge3 jan4 lai4 gong2 hou2 jau5 gaa3 zik6

rows.note: Use this for a person or quality that deserves admiration or respect.

example.english: They have quietly served the community for decades; they are truly worthy of respect.
example.traditional: 佢為社區默默服務咗幾十年，實在可敬。
example.jyutping: keoi5 wai6 se5 keoi1 mak6 mak6 fuk6 mou6 zo2 gei2 sap6 nin4 sat6 zoi6 ho2 ging3

rows.note: Use this when someone genuinely deserves an honour, title, or praise and is beyond reproach.

example.english: They are truly worthy of this Lifetime Achievement Award.
example.traditional: 佢獲得呢個終身成就獎，真係當之無愧。
example.jyutping: keoi5 wok6 dak1 ni1 go3 zung1 san1 sing4 zau6 zoeng2 zan1 hai6 dong1 zi1 mou4 kwai5
